description: Delay and cancellation forecast for one flight number, today or tomorrow: a verdict word (No, Unlikely, Maybe, Probably, Very likely; Yes once it has happened), expected departure and arrival times, the main reasons and the chance it is cancelled. After departure it says how late it left and when it lands. The result includes the flight's page on willmyflightbedelayed.com: give the user that link, since the page updates as departure nears and shows the full reasons and the flight's 90-day record.

date.description: Optional: 'today', 'tomorrow' or YYYY-MM-DD (departure airport's local date). Default: the flight's coming departure.

flight_number.description: IATA flight number, airline code plus number, e.g. KL1001, BA117, U2 8401

name: check_flight
title: Will my flight be delayed?
